text: Ink Whale Leap（水墨鲸跃）是一款面向 DSH 网页端的开场动画插件。它通过监听 webserver/index-inject 注入内联脚本，在页面载入时覆盖显示水墨风格的鲸跃、扩散水纹和文字标识，并在数秒后自动淡出移除；用户也可按 Esc 提前关闭，减少动态效果偏好会调整动画。适合希望为 DSH 网页界面增加简短欢迎动效的用户。插件不要求额外配置，也没有实现运行时外部服务调用。

Ink Whale Leap adds a brief ink-wash whale animation to the DSH web UI on page load. It injects an inline script, shows a whale and water rings, then fades and removes the overlay; Esc dismisses it early. No extra configuration is needed. (index.js:66-91; splash.js:111-143)
想让 DSH 网页打开时先出现一段水墨鲸鱼动画。
给 DSH 的网页界面加一个会自动消失的开场欢迎效果。
Can I add a short animated splash screen to the DSH web UI?
Ink Whale Leap 的功能「网页开场动画」：在 DSH 网页载入时显示水墨鲸跃、扩散水纹和文字标识，随后自动淡出并从页面移除；按 Esc 可提前关闭。

dsh-ink-whale-leap README · Ink Whale Leap · 水墨鲸跃：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the web UI when the page loads, then fades out by itself.

section: Ink Whale Leap · 水墨鲸跃

text: dsh-ink-whale-leap README · What it shows：A full-window overlay in the palette of an ink wash on paper: the whale rises out of the still water, three ink rings spread from the waterline, a few ink drops scatter upward, and the wordmark `DeepSeek Harness` settles in with a red `鲸` seal and the line `鲸跃 · 与你同游`.

dsh-ink-whale-leap README · What it shows：- 3.95 s after the page loads the overlay fades, and it is removed from the DOM at 4.75 s.
- `Esc` dismisses it immediately.
- With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the animations are turned off.
- If the tab is hidden when the page loads, playback waits for the tab to become visible (15 s fallback).
- The overlay is decorative: `aria-hidden="true"`, `pointer-events: none`, so it never takes clicks or keyboard focus.

dsh-ink-whale-leap README · Install：Once the plugin is listed in the DSH plugin market, install it from Settings → Plugins. From a command line:

```
dsh plugin add dsh-ink-whale-leap
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installing it adds one loader row — there is no client bundle to approve.
dsh-ink-whale-leap README · Preview without installing：Open `preview.html` in a browser from a checkout of this repository; it loads `splash.js` against a blank page.

dsh-ink-whale-leap README · How it works：This is a host-only plugin. It reacts to `webserver/index-inject` by pushing a single inline `<script>` row, and serves the animation source at `/ink-whale/splash.js` from the `webServer` service.

dsh-ink-whale-leap README · How it works：There is deliberately no client entry point: in DSH, a client bundle that fails to activate aborts the web boot, and a launch animation is not worth that risk. Every step of activation is wrapped in `try/catch`, so a missing service or a failing injection leaves the app untouched instead of breaking it.

The animation itself is one self-contained IIFE with inline CSS and SVG (`splash.js`) — no network requests, no fonts, no images.
dsh-ink-whale-leap README · Configuration：None. The plugin has no settings page and no options.
dsh-ink-whale-leap README · Uninstall：Remove it the same way as any other plugin (market uninstall, or `dsh plugin remove dsh-ink-whale-leap`).

dsh-ink-whale-leap README · Notes：- The animation runs once per page load, on every window that loads the web UI — it is not a once-per-install welcome screen.
- It only paints over the web UI; the desktop window chrome is unaffected.
